annotations.text:
The thirty point kit back, with nothing to buy.
Every hull's shipped profile is its default spend, so picking a ship and flying needs no editor at all. TUNE on the ship you fly opens the stepper page; one remembered build a hull; RESET is the whole build manager. Prices here are stand-ins that make Apex's default sum to 30.
The open fork: whether flight is spendable too. This board sketches that side. The recommendation is no, so ships stay ships; the points live in gun, bomb and rack.
